data.name: Lucky Pikinini - IMS Intelligence Corp
data.detailed_description:
Engine: Unreal Engine 4, Development Time: 5 Year Span ( From 2022 to 2026 ), Scale: Large Scale,

IMS Intelligence Corp

IMS Intelligence Corp is a Large-Scale First Person / Third Person Story-Telling Game with a 13-Chapter Story Campaign, 4-Maps Special Missions & 33 Maps Survival Mode, 4th Installment In the Super Incursion Series and the Biggest/ Longest And Most Ambitious Entry to the Series surpassing all previous entries. Takes place at the same-time same-place as the Events of the Original Super Incursion And IMS Death Squad so while those stories are unfolding this one is happening at the same time and it interacts with those stories events.  IMS Intelligence Corp's Story Campaign follows the Intelligence Corp team 1 of 3 IMS Teams deployed to Advanced City, Gemstone Island to carry out Operation: Winter Strike. You take control of IMS Private Daryl Kalashi an Intelligence Officer, The Intelligence Corp team is the Intelligence Gathering And Processing unit of the Winter Strike mission made up of IMS Intelligence Officers unlike other teams that are made up of Special Forces Soldiers. They are a small unit of the much larger IMS Intelligence Division and they work closely with the Advanced City IMS Base. They're job is to carry out enemy survillience, intercept and process enemy communications, process environment layouts to aid in military advances, communicate with and gather data from spies in the enemy side, process and provide any data that can aid the 2 other teams in the operation. 

CONTEXT: At the start of the operation, The Intelligence Corp team is the first of the 3 teams to leave for and arrive in Advanced City, with Specialized Force being the last. When They got there they got split, majority of Daryl's team was sent directly to the Advanced City IMS Base to join members of the IMS Intelligence Division there while Daryl Kalashi is sent off to do some very important tasks. 

IMS Intelligence Corp (Game) was developed from the ground up as the biggest, longest and most ambitious Super Incursion Installment to date, its story campaign is longer than all previous installments campaigns. Its got the largest amount of Launch content than any other installment. Its Story is 13 Chapters long each chapter being 45 mins to 1 hour to complete. Its got 33 different individual survival maps each being 2 hours to complete. IMS Intelligence Corp is the largest game in terms of how much playable Base Content it has. 

-SUPER INCURSION STORY AND TIMELINE EXPLAINED:

Story Explanation for those who havint played the Original Super Incursion (game) or IMS Death Squad (game), If you have then you can skip this and go on to Gamemodes: 

Operation: Winter Strike is a military operation created by the Gemstone Communist People's Ministry of Defense, Gemstone Armed Forces and IMS ( Incursion Military Service ) to carry out reconnaissance on a new CGT Protocol, Protocol 87 and find ways to sabotage it before it takes off, 3 IMS teams are sent to advanced city being 1.Specialized Force [the team you play as in the Original Super Incursion], 2.Death Squad [the team you play as in IMS Death Squad (game)] and finally 3. Intelligence Corp, [the team you play as in IMS Intelligence Corp (game) this game]. These 3 IMS teams travel from Crystalville City to Gemstone Island Capital: Advanced City to carry out the operation. The CGT (Con-Federation of Global Terrorism) are responsible for coordinating and master minding the Global Biological Genocide, the event which killed 80% of the human population turning the world into an overgrown dystopia in an attempt to seize full global control. Now they are carrying out additional plans to consolidate power and strengthen they're grip on the world. They are attempting to become a Nuclear Capable Global Military Super Power, If they succedd They're leader: Super Powered CGT Supreme General John Voorhies will control the world.

IMS Intelligence Corp's Story is the longest, its starts before all the other games stories and continues beyond their endings, and its ending sets up the story for Super Incursion 2, the next chapter in the Super Incursion story set in Walled Crystalville City.

Gamemodes: IMS Intelligence Corp has 3 Playable Modes: Story Mode, Special Missions and Survival Mode.

1.Story Mode is the Story Campaign its 13 Chapters Long and should take any where between 13 to 12 Hours to complete. Every chapter presents the player with different environments ( secondary school, military underground facility network, shopping malls, government offices, residential areas, underground mines etc. ) these different places bring different tasks and challenges.

2. Special Missions allows the player to play Special Missions which the IMS carried out against the CGT before Operation: Winter Strike. The player has to play and complete story driven special missions. Each mission has 6 objectives they must complete racing against time the player has 3 teammates which provide aid and can die and respawn multiple times. getting kills, assists, completing objectives and healing rewards players with XP, completing full missions gives the player bonus XP that will allow them to rank up unlocking new weapons and upgrades that will allow them to create better loadouts that they can bring into special missions. Max Level is 60.

3. Survival Mode: IMS Intelligence Corp has the biggest survival mode than any other Super Incursion title with almost 50% of the development time put towards it. We wanted to create a survival mode that is dynamic and highly modifiable, providing the ability to modify as many elements as possible, the player selects a map out of many available and they are set it in wide range of environments ( war trenchs, shopping malls, supermarket, civilian schools, rural areas, tailors, government offices, industrial areas, shipping container ports ) these different maps provide different gameplay and level design scenarios, the player in each of these maps can change the DayTime (sunset, sunrise, daytime, night, dawn) change the Weather ( rainy, clear sky, partly cloudy, thunder storm, windy, foggy, rainy with fog) choose whether the map should be Dry, Muddy with water puddles, Flooded with high water levels, Then they are given options to choose how many waves to survive 15 ~ 30 waves or even Infinite Waves,  Change Inter-wave time delay, change aiming reticle, disable HUD elements, Disable Enemy Dogs and Juggernauts, Receive Bouncing Bettys (S-Mines) instead of Pipebombs per new wave, get 1 new medikit per new wave, They can even choose to START the Survival Match with they're Story Mode Inventory or start with Nothing but just a Makarov Pistol. This survival mode has so many Guns ( AUG, AS-Val, AK-47, RPK, AKS-74U, AMELI / MG-82, FG-42, VSS, P90, MP5, MP7, MP9, MP28-II, MP-40, TYPE-99 NAMBU, SVD, SCAR-L, M1-Garand, M4-A1, M4-A5, M16, M1911, Uniqually, DP-27, USP-45, Makarov, Rivet Gun, Skorpion, Ballistic Knife and many more ), and so many weapon customizations ( Drum Mag, Suppressor, Flash hider, Extended Mag, Reflex Sights, Pistol Reflex Sights, Vertical Grips, Over 65 Different Gun CAMOS to Apply ) You can even buy Kits which convert SEMI-AUTO pistols to FULL-AUTO.

MOTORIZED RAIL MACHINE

THE MOTORIZED RAIL MACHINE - The Motorized Rail Machine is the Machine that is utilized to traverse across horizontal rails above the ground allowing the player to rapidly travel across large areas and even engage enemy targets from above. The Motorized Rail Machine is available in Story Mode and Survival Mode. 

WEAPON CUSTOMIZATION / GUN SMITH - In the Story Mode Advanced Station you can manually modify different weapon parts and build a weapon of your choice, for example you can modify an M4-A1 with parts of an M4-A5, modify an AK-47 with parts of AKS-74U, AK-74, AKS-74, RPK, AK-12, AK-74M, RPK-74, GALIL and many more creating unique firearms. After changing the gun parts you can mount attachments on the firearm like ( Drum Mag, Suppressor, Flash hider, Extended Mag, Reflex Sights, Vertical Grips ). Modification alters how the guns function. 

IMS INTELLIGENCE CORP INHERITS ELEMENTS FROM PREVIOUS INSTALLMENTS such as Auto-Saves of Story Equipment and Checkpoints of Story Progress, New Game + after completing the Story Mode allowing you to replay it with your inventory, Permanent Death ( Perma-Death ) for experienced Players, Improved Advanced Stations, Its has brought a bigger gameplay loop with more better puzzles, enemies, refined existing mechanics and improved graphical fidelity. It has totally brand new elements unseen in previous games like Elevators, Cargo Lifts, Tectonic Load Mass Load Elevators, Crawling through Air-Vents, Gun smith etc.

DEVELOPMENT TIME OF THIS PROJECT IS 2022 to 2026. A SPAN OF 5 YEARS, IT USES UNREAL ENGINE 4 TECHNOLOGY.

IMS Intelligence Corp is big and took so many years to create and it presents a Beautiful Overgrown Lush Environment but a dangerous one, The CGT are willing to do whatever it takes for power they are prepared to kill anyone who stands in theyre way and they will stop at nothing until they achieve total global control and many people are just fighting to try and stay alive in a harsh unforgiving environment. Its a dangerous world where great powers clash, CGT trying to control the world and many factions trying to stop it,  a world where alot of people die as collateral damage as the fighting unfolds in populated cities. The IMS and GAF try to avoid any civilian casualities, The CGT dont care who dies in its war to achieve global power. Gemstone Island is a ticking time bomb, violence can explode any time, People die in random executions, people get shot and killed anytime by gangs and stray bullets, you can get shot and killed anytime any place. Its a Dangerous Unstable Lawless Warzone were war-crimes are a common place. Its a Beautiful Overgrown Environment but a harsh one. An Incredible World Awaits You in this Large-Scale Title and we cannot wait for you to get your hands on it and start your adventure and we profondly appreciate everyone who does. This game was developed to be the Biggest Super Incursion Game Of All Time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3rd Generation
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 720 Ti or Intel Dedicated Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: HDD works but SSD is recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 8th Generation
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1080 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SDD Recommended for better performance

content_descriptors.notes: When Player Gets Injured By Enemies He Bleeds On The Ground, When Enemies Get Shot They Bleed On The Ground, Enemies Can Get Dismembered or Decapitated By Gunshots Or Explosive Charges. There Are Images Of Nazi Symbols Of The Gemstone Nazi Party, The Party Has Nothing To Do With The German Nazi Party. Gemstone Nazi Party Is Its Own Separate Entity And Has Its Own Rules And Regulations. There Are Profanity Threats By Armed Organizations Competing For Territory And Power Threating Rival Organizations To Stay Off Them. There Are Executed Bodies With Decapitation And Dismemberment As A Warning A Group Sending A Clear Message Threating Other Groups Of What Will Happen If They Keep Challenging Them.
